text: Anya - driving test Thurs, 3rd attempt. v nervous. text gd luck wed night

Tiago moving to Lisbon end of Nov - new job w/ a fintech there. flat viewings this wknd via video call, 3 lined up in Alfama/Graça. worried abt rent, everything's gone up 30%. his gf Marisol staying here til spring then joining him. he's selling his PS5 + half his records. ask which flat he went for on Mon, and maybe take him for a farewell pint before he goes
Marta @ book club - obsessed w/ Ishiguro rn, re-reading Klara. her bday Dec 2nd -> signed copy?
Matteo grade 6 piano exam May 14. practising 2hrs/day. his mum v stressed abt it, he's fine apparently
Eva & Pieter - viewing a 2 bed in Leith Sat. 1st time buyers. ask how it went
Kofi - results day for ACCA tmrw. need to message him after lunch
bins out tues. dentist 10/3 @ 9:15
Michael (Mikey) - Arsenal season ticket, never misses a home game. hates Spurs w/ a passion

Hadiza audition for the Royal Conservatoire Feb 7th - cello, playing the Elgar 1st mvmt + a Bach suite. said she's barely sleeping, keeps getting stuck on the same run. her teacher Dr Santos thinks she's more than ready. her parents driving her up to Glasgow the day before. don't forget to send something the night before, and ask how it went once she's back
Neha's flat viewing cancelled - landlord pulled it. still looking in Hackney. budget tight
Chidi passed his driving test!! 2 minors. congrats msg + maybe card
Rosa - knitting a blanket for her niece, 4th one this yr. into chunky merino. Xmas present hint: nice yarn bowl
Joanna moving Fri. I'm helping load the van from 8am. she has a cat, Biscuit, who hates the carrier
Marcus - GCSE mocks start next Mon. his dad says he's not revising at all. Marcus himself seems chill
Tadhg into bouldering now, goes @ The Climbing Hangar 3x wk. wants proper shoes for bday (Jan 19)
Alina & Nikolai Petrov - moving to Berlin in a fortnight. leaving do Sat 6/21 at theirs

Lukas - bar exam results Oct 28. been really low abt it, convinced he failed the ethics paper. his flatmate Milan says he's barely leaving his room. not even going to 5 a side anymore & he never misses that. his mum flying over from Munich that week. check in this wkend, maybe drag him to the pub quiz Thurs
Milan's sister Ifeoma got into Edinburgh for medicine. he's buzzing

Mariam - sold the house finally, completion Dec 12th after 8 months of chain nightmares. renting short term in Leeds till spring, then looking to buy nr Roundhay. her son Kofi starting at a new school there in Jan, he's not thrilled. she's been doing loads of crochet to stay sane - amigurumi animals mostly. need to send her the removals guy's number
Meera chess club - plays Sundays, rated ~1700 online. asked me to play blitz sometime
call Javier re the flat in Bristol - viewing was yesterday, did he put an offer in?
Ricardo - theory test next Tues 2pm. 2nd go. he's dyslexic, finds the hazard perception bit hard
Anan - started a Warhammer army, Space Marines. paints minis every eve. totally hooked
Ayesha's mum has her citizenship test Nov 4. Ayesha doing practice qs w/ her nightly
Dalia moving in w/ her bf Tobi next month. joint flat in Didsbury. said she's nervous abt the commute
Marisol: half marathon training, Valencia Dec 7. long run Sun 18mi. remind me to send her the playlist
Kerry - choir audition went well apparently, find out Fri if she's in. ask her Sat

Neha + her brother Kofi both doing CFA level 1 Nov 23. study together at the library weekends, quizzing each other on the bus. Neha's quietly confident, Kofi less so - he failed it in May & is scared of failing again in front of their dad. results Jan sometime. remind me to text them both gd luck the Fri before
groceries, return parcel, renew passport b4 June. sort car MOT
Tobi - huge Afrobeats fan, Burna Boy gig @ O2 next Thurs. dragging his mate along
Pieter's dog Bruno had surgery on his leg mon, recovering ok. Pieter v shaken tho
Marta - dance exam (ballet grade 8) this Sat 3/22. she's a wreck. text her fri eve
Matteo moving to Manchester for uni Sept. halls booked. his mum Mrs Costa v emotional
Eva's driving test cancelled - examiner off sick. rebooked for Apr 9
must ask Chidi abt the flat - viewing tmrw 6pm, 2 bed nr Brixton. he wants a garden for the dog

Michael & his wife Rosa - house hunting in Surrey, 3 viewings this Sat, another Weds. kids starting new school in Jan so time pressure. Rosa wants a garden for the chickens lol, Michael just wants a shed for his model railway. their offer on the Guildford one fell through last month. ask Michael next wk if anything came of Sat
Anya - into sourdough, starter called Doughy McDoughface lol. bakes every Sunday
Kerry's son Tadhg has his 11+ exam Sept 14. Kerry more nervous than he is. drop her a text that morning
Javier back from Madrid - flat search there went nowhere. staying in London for now
Hadiza - plays Catan obsessively, wants the Seafarers expansion. 'just saying' x3 -> bday?
Lukas Tanaka - new job in Osaka, moves Jan 6th. selling his bike & sofa. I said I'd buy the sofa
need to ring Ricardo friday - theory test result. he was gutted last time
Alina - viola recital June 3rd @ St Martin's, 7pm. I'm going w/ Nikolai. buy flowers beforehand
Mariam's grandad passed last wk. funeral Tues. she's moving back home for a bit to help her nan

Ifeoma (Ify) - sitting her MRCS part A on 5/14. been revising since Jan, says she's dreading it. her husband Kofi doing all the cooking so she can study. send good luck on the 13th + ask how it went after
Meera's flat flooded - moving out tmrw into a friend's spare room. insurance being slow. she sounded exhausted. offer the van
Marcus - plays FIFA online w/ his cousins, top 100 in his division. Chelsea fan
Dalia passed her PhD viva today!! minor corrections. celebration drinks Fri @ the Crown
Tiago's partner Milan - just got the keys to their 1st place. housewarming next Sat. bring plant
spoke w/ Anan re: piano grade 5, exam's 11/2. teacher thinks he's ready, he doesn't. he's practising scales til midnight. don't forget to text gd luck day before

Joanna - started pottery @ the community centre Weds eves. made me a mug, wonky but cute. she's now looking at second hand kilns online, wants to sell stuff at the Xmas market Dec 14th. her husband Marcus is building her a shelf in the garage. totally obsessed, talks abt glazes nonstop. maybe a glaze set for her bday in March?
Nikolai - Petrov family moving to Toronto in Aug. his sister Anya staying here for uni. ask him how the visa interview went last Thurs
Tobi's mum retiring end of month, party Sun 8/17. he wants to get her a gardening set, asked me to chip in
Ayesha - Taekwondo black belt grading this weekend!! training 5 days a wk. been injured (knee) so a bit worried. text her Sun to see how it went
Pieter - collects vinyl, mostly 70s jazz & soul. mentioned wanting the Blue Note Kind of Blue reissue. note for xmas

Marisol's driving lessons going badly - failed twice, test #3 on July 10th. her instructor's leaving too. she's thinking of switching to automatic. Rosa's offered to take her out practising Sundays. should check in w/ her early next wk
house viewing @ 4 tmrw, then again Sat 11am for 2nd look. mortgage meeting Mon
Kofi Lewis - new flat in Peckham, moved in last Sun. ask if the boiler's sorted
Eva - Liverpool fan, been to Anfield every season since she was 6. her dad Michael took her first

Matteo's results day Aug 15 - A levels, needs AAB for Bristol. tried to sound relaxed but obv anxious. his gf Neha's results same day. message both that afternoon, then maybe dinner the wknd after? I'm already planning to cook for his bday Aug 22 anyway
